title: General Tech Discovery
description: Explore the universal foundations of computer science: algorithmic thinking, software architecture, web protocols, version control, and career trajectory discovery.

goal.objective: Build an unshakeable computer science foundation, identify your engineering passions, and transition confidently into high-demand technical career tracks.

learn.summary: Master computational thinking, algorithmic logic, computer systems fundamentals, client-server networking, command-line mastery, and Git version control.
key_competencies: Data Structures (Arrays, Hash Maps, Linked Lists, Trees)
Git Version Control & GitHub Collaborative Workflows
prerequisites: Curiosity about how technology and software work

capstone_projects.title: Personal Developer Portfolio & Interactive Project Showcase
capstone_projects.description: Build and deploy a responsive personal developer portfolio showcasing interactive mini-projects, dark/light theme, and live demo links.

capstone_projects.title: Distributed Key-Value Store & Consensus Simulator
capstone_projects.description: Build an educational distributed key-value store implementing leader election, log replication, and atomic updates to understand real-world system resilience.

interview_focus: Explaining How the Internet and DNS Resolution Works
Basic Time and Space Complexity (Big-O Notation)
Git Branching, Rebasing and Merge Conflicts

stages.title: Computer Science Foundations

topics.name: How Computers Work: Architecture & OS Basics
topics.description: Understand the fundamental components: binary representation, CPU, memory hierarchy, input/output, operating systems (kernel, processes, filesystems), and network interfaces.

resources.title: Code: The Hidden Language of Computer Hardware and Software
Computer Science Full Course for Beginners

topics.name: Internet & Web Essentials: Protocols & Client-Server
topics.description: Grasp how the internet functions: IP addresses, DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS. Understand client-server architecture, web browsers, web servers, APIs, and the flow of information across the network.

resources.title: HTTP: The Protocol Every Web Developer Must Know
How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes (Aaron)

topics.name: Version Control: Git and GitHub for Collaboration
topics.description: Master the basics of Git for tracking code changes, committing, branching, and merging. Learn to use GitHub for hosting repositories, pull requests, code reviews, and project management.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

topics.name: Introduction to Logic and Discrete Mathematics
topics.description: Explore foundational logical reasoning, propositional logic, sets, basic counting principles, and an overview of algorithmic thinking that underpins computer science.

resources.title: Maths for Programmers: Introduction (What Is Discrete Mathematics?) (freeCodeCamp.org)

project.title: Foundational Concepts Learning Journal
project.description: Create a GitHub repository containing your notes, simplified diagrams, explanations of concepts (e.g., 'How DNS works'), and small code snippets illustrating foundational principles. Include weekly reflections.

stages.description: Understand universal computer science principles: binary data representation, CPU execution cycles, memory management, and operating system kernels.

stages.title: Programming and Problem Solving

topics.name: Programming Core Concepts (e.g., Python)
topics.description: Learn variables, data types, operators, conditional statements (if/else), loops (for/while), functions, modules, error handling, and debugging techniques using a high-level language like Python.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]

topics.name: Data Structures and Algorithms Foundations
topics.description: Understand fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash maps, and trees. Learn basic algorithms for searching (linear, binary) and sorting (bubble, selection, insertion). Grasp Big O notation for complexity analysis.

resources.title: Grokking Algorithms: An illustrated guide for programmers and other curious people
Algorithms and Data Structures Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
topics.description: Learn the core principles of OOP: classes, objects, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Understand how to design and structure code using these concepts for maintainability and scalability.

resources.title: Python OOP Tutorial 1: Classes and Instances (Corey Schafer)

topics.name: Practice: Build Small Programs & Solve Challenges
topics.description: Apply your programming knowledge by building 5-10 small command-line interface (CLI) tools (e.g., calculator, simple to-do list, quiz game, file organizer, password generator). Solve introductory algorithmic problems on platforms like Exercism or LeetCode.

resources.title: Getting Started Building a Python CLI With argparse (Real Python)
5 Problem Solving Tips for Cracking Coding Interview Questions (CS Dojo)

project.title: Personal CLI Toolkit & Problem Solver
project.description: Develop a collection of 3-5 command-line tools that demonstrate core programming concepts and problem-solving skills. Each tool should have a clear README, usage instructions, and documented code. Include solutions to 5-10 fundamental DSA problems.

stages.description: Master fundamental algorithmic problem solving, time and space complexity analysis (Big-O), and essential data structures.

stages.title: Explore Major Tech Tracks

topics.name: Web Development Taste Test: Frontend Basics
topics.description: Build static web pages using HTML for structure and CSS for styling. Learn basic JavaScript to add interactivity, manipulate the DOM, and handle user input. Understand responsive design principles.

resources.title: MDN Learn Web Development - Front-end basics
Introduction To Responsive Web Design - HTML & CSS Tutorial (freeCodeCamp.org)
Learn HTML5 and CSS3 From Scratch - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
JavaScript Crash Course For Beginners (Traversy Media)

topics.name: Web Development Taste Test: Backend & Database Intro
topics.description: Explore the server-side: setting up a basic web server (e.g., using Flask/Node.js Express), routing requests, and interacting with simple databases (e.g., SQLite, PostgreSQL) for data storage and retrieval.

resources.title: Learn Flask for Python - Full Tutorial (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Data Science & AI Taste Test: Analysis & Basic ML
topics.description: Get an overview of data analysis using tools like spreadsheets and Python (Pandas). Learn basic SQL for querying data, data visualization (Matplotlib/Seaborn), and an introduction to machine learning concepts like supervised vs. unsupervised learning with a simple prediction or classification example.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
topics.description: Understand the basics of cloud computing: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS. Explore core services like EC2 (compute), S3 (storage), and VPC (networking) on a major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). Learn about virtual machines, containers (Docker overview), and basic deployment.

resources.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Certification Course 2026 (CLF-C02) - Pass the Exam! (freeCodeCamp.org)
Docker Crash Course for Absolute Beginners [NEW] (TechWorld with Nana)

topics.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals and Best Practices
topics.description: Discover common security threats (phishing, malware), basic defensive measures (firewalls, encryption, strong passwords), and the importance of secure coding practices. Explore network security concepts and ethical hacking overview.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks
Full Ethical Hacking Course - Network Penetration Testing for Beginners (2019) (freeCodeCamp.org)

project.title: Multi-Track Tech Sampler Portfolio
project.description: Develop three mini-projects, one for each major track: a simple interactive web page (frontend + backend API call), a data analysis notebook with visualizations and a basic ML model, and a cloud-based 'hello world' application or a basic security lab setup. Document your learnings and preferences.

stages.description: Learn core software engineering tools: Unix/Linux command-line navigation, Git version control, collaborative workflows, and code hygiene.

stages.title: Career Choice and Portfolio Direction

topics.name: Self-Assessment: Interests, Strengths, and Work Style
topics.description: Reflect on your experiences from the 'taste tests'. Identify your preferences for visual design, complex logic, data analysis, systems architecture, security, communication, and problem-solving. Understand different work environments (startup vs. enterprise).

resources.title: What Kind of Developer Are You?
How to Start Your Dream Career in Tech in 7 Steps (with Susan Clark) (CareerFoundry)
How to Start Your Dream Career in Tech in 7 Steps (with Susan Clark) (CareerFoundry)

topics.name: Exploring Tech Industry Roles and Trends
topics.description: Research common tech roles (e.g., Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, Data Scientist, DevOps Engineer, Cybersecurity Analyst, UX Designer). Understand typical responsibilities, required skill sets, and current industry demand and trends for each.

resources.title: Hired 2024 State of Tech Salaries Report
Top Tech Jobs for 2025: High Demand & High Pay (Programming with Mosh)
Top Tech Jobs for 2025: High Demand & High Pay (Programming with Mosh)

topics.name: Crafting an Impactful Portfolio & Storytelling
topics.description: Learn to effectively present your projects. Focus on clear READMEs, explaining your thought process, challenges faced, solutions implemented, and what you learned. Use screenshots, live demos, and concise explanations to showcase your skills and tell your unique journey.

resources.title: Learn HTML5 and CSS3 From Scratch - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
GitHub Profile Tips to standout (& stay secure) | GitHub tutorial (GitHub)

topics.name: Personal Career Path Research & Planning
topics.description: Based on your self-assessment and role research, select 1-2 target specializations. Explore specific SkillBun roadmaps for these roles, identify key skills gaps, and begin outlining a personalized 30/60/90-day learning and project plan.

resources.title: How to Create a 30-60-90 Day Plan
The Complete Backend Developer Roadmap (Programming with Mosh)
How to Build an Effective Career Plan (Top 5 Tips) (CareerAddict)

topics.name: Networking and Community Engagement
topics.description: Understand the importance of professional networking. Learn how to connect with mentors, participate in online communities (e.g., Discord, Stack Overflow), attend virtual meetups, and leverage platforms like LinkedIn for career growth.

resources.title: How to use LinkedIn for job hunting (LinkedIn Learning)
How to Network with ZERO Working Experience! (Jeff Su)
5 LinkedIn Profile Tips that Get You Hired (backed by data) (Jeff Su)

project.title: Personal Specialization Roadmap & Portfolio Strategy
project.description: Develop a detailed 30-day learning plan for your chosen specialization, including weekly outcomes and a proposed core portfolio project. Outline a strategy for how you will present your existing 'discovery' projects and future specialized work to demonstrate your skills and progress.

stages.description: Explore modern technology domains, distributed web architecture, cloud primitives, and map a personalized strategic engineering career trajectory.

tree.name: Computer Science Foundations
tree.description: Build an unshakeable computer science foundation: understand computer hardware and operating systems, the architecture of the internet, collaborative version control with Git, and mathematical logic.

children.name: How Computers Work: Architecture & OS Basics
children.description: Understand computer architecture and operating systems from the metal up: binary representation, the CPU instruction cycle (Fetch-Decode-Execute), memory hierarchy (L1/L2/L3 caches, RAM, virtual memory paging), operating system kernels, processes vs threads, and file system organization.

resources.title: Code: The Hidden Language of Computer Hardware and Software
Computer Science Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Internet & Web Essentials: Protocols & Client-Server
children.description: Understand the mechanics of the internet: IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), DNS resolution pathways, TCP vs UDP transport protocols, the HTTP/HTTPS request-response lifecycle, client-server architectures, and how web browsers parse and render pages.

resources.title: HTTP: The Protocol Every Web Developer Must Know
How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes (Aaron)

children.name: Version Control: Git and GitHub for Collaboration
children.description: Master collaborative version control with Git and GitHub: understanding the working directory, staging area, and commit history, creating feature branches, executing pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and navigating open-source repositories.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Introduction to Logic and Discrete Mathematics
children.description: Master foundational mathematical logic for computer science: Boolean algebra and truth tables, set theory, functions, combinatorics, mathematical induction, and elementary graph theory concepts essential for algorithmic problem solving.

resources.title: Maths for Programmers: Introduction (What Is Discrete Mathematics?) (freeCodeCamp.org)

tree.name: Programming and Problem Solving
tree.description: Master algorithmic thinking and software development: programming fundamentals in Python, core data structures, object-oriented architecture, and structured problem solving.

children.name: Programming Core Concepts (e.g., Python)
children.description: Master core programming concepts in Python: variables, primitive and collection data types, control flow structures (loops, conditionals), function definitions and variable scope, modular programming, and robust error handling using try-except blocks.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]

children.name: Data Structures and Algorithms Foundations
children.description: Master essential data structures and algorithms: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Hash Tables, and Binary Search Trees. Analyze algorithm efficiency using Big-O notation for time and space complexity, and master linear vs binary search and sorting algorithms.

resources.title: Grokking Algorithms: An illustrated guide for programmers and other curious people
Algorithms and Data Structures Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
children.description: Master Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles: classes and instances, encapsulation of state, abstraction of complex operations, inheritance hierarchies, polymorphism, and composition patterns for writing modular, reusable code.

resources.title: Python OOP Tutorial 1: Classes and Instances (Corey Schafer)

children.name: Practice: Build Small Programs & Solve Challenges
children.description: Develop structured technical problem-solving skills: dissecting ambiguous project requirements into algorithmic steps, writing pseudocode, identifying edge cases (empty inputs, boundary limits), writing unit assertions, and debugging code systematically.

resources.title: Getting Started Building a Python CLI With argparse (Real Python)
5 Problem Solving Tips for Cracking Coding Interview Questions (CS Dojo)

tree.name: Explore Major Tech Tracks

children.name: Web Development Taste Test: Frontend Basics

resources.title: MDN Learn Web Development - Front-end basics
Introduction To Responsive Web Design - HTML & CSS Tutorial (freeCodeCamp.org)
Learn HTML5 and CSS3 From Scratch - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Web Development Taste Test: Backend & Database Intro
children.description: Explore backend web development: designing RESTful APIs, handling HTTP request methods, querying relational databases with SQL (tables, keys, queries), NoSQL document storage, and server-side data persistence.

resources.title: Learn Flask for Python - Full Tutorial (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Data Science & AI Taste Test: Analysis & Basic ML
children.description: Explore data science and artificial intelligence: tabular data analysis with Python and Pandas, statistical charting, the fundamentals of supervised and unsupervised machine learning, and modern generative AI models.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
